Title: Current Validation Baseline
Content: The active validation baseline should be tracked under this stable ID. As of 2026-06-01, the test suite contains approximately 419 [Test] methods across 36+ NUnit fixtures covering unit, integration (WebApplicationFactory), SQLite metadata, auth/audit/history, markdown rendering, chat/agent tool calls, task/governance flows, code search (22 tests), and a [Category("Benchmark")] search-quality suite. Repository KB-health checks via Scripts/Test-PageLinks.ps1, Scripts/Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1, Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1, and Scripts/Test-MemoryRecords.ps1 pass in CI. The CI workflow (ci.yml) collects Cobertura coverage and publishes HTML reports but does not enforce a coverage threshold. Playwright e2e tests cover 6 route-smoke paths and 5 navigation-freeze scenarios across two browser jobs.
